children: Benitec Biopharma Inc. reported a net loss of $45.5M for fiscal 2026, compared with a $37.9M loss in fiscal 2025, with no product revenue recognized in either year and diluted EPS of $(0.98) for FY 2026 versus $(1.05) in FY 2025.
Revenue: $0 for FY 2026 and FY 2025 (no product revenue recognized).
Net income: Net loss attributable to common shareholders $45.5M for FY 2026, compared with net loss $37.9M for FY 2025.
Diluted earnings per share: $(0.98) for FY 2026, compared with $(1.05) for FY 2025.
Clinical progress: Continued advancement of BB-301, a silence-and-replace gene therapy candidate for OPMD, with ongoing clinical development activities.
R&D investment: Research and development spending increased to $23.4M to support clinical and preclinical trials and manufacturing.

Capital raise and liquidity: Completed $104.5M of equity issuances in November 2025, providing cash runway to fund operations and near-term milestones; cash position approximately $180M supports at least 12 months of planned development and regulatory activities.
Operational scale-up: Higher payroll and share-based compensation reflect increases in headcount to support clinical, regulatory, and corporate functions.
